verdict.rationale: vLLM's own documentation lists "Streaming outputs" as a core feature, alongside an OpenAI-compatible API server that applications integrate with directly. That is direct support for streaming tokens as they are generated, but the evidence is only a feature-list line with no detail on how streaming works. Missing for 10: documentation of the streaming mechanism (e.g. SSE / stream=true on completion endpoints), per-endpoint coverage, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream generated tokens back to my application as they are produced

citations.quote: OpenAI-compatible API server, plus Anthropic Messages API and gRPC support
